protocol.name: D9b generic pre-probe history reconstruction
protocol.purpose: construct causally aligned temporal input for the D9b history factorial
protocol.scope: all 256 TRAIN nested groups; no task labels, alarm labels, DEV, or TEST

history.construction: warm-start-safe replay to the original chunk snapshot, then execute the D3 source path through its contact_step; retain the final four states and three transitions
history.generic_channels_only: block pose and velocity, contact signature, gripper proprioception, and executed controls

execution.reason: avoid desktop resource exhaustion and reproduce D3 deterministically

decision.pass: freeze history cache and authorize the fit-only 2-by-2 temporal factorial
decision.fail: do not train; diagnose simulator/version or source-index mismatch
